blurb: Musekids Dansica offers ballet classes for children and adults, musical theatre classes for children, private dance lessons, and intensive ballet camps in Paris and Canada. Programs range from beginner to pre-professional levels and include summer intensives, community classes, and touring orchestra programs. They provide both group classes and private lessons with options for drop-in or packages.
